description: Changes title, description, price or limits, packs (null removes them), required fields or successUrl. Only the fields passed change; the slug — and so the printed QR — stays the same. Invoices already created are not affected.

amount.description: Fixed price in KZT; null lets the customer type the amount

collect.description: Fields the customer must fill in before paying

maxAmount.description: Upper limit for a customer-entered amount

minAmount.description: Lower limit for a customer-entered amount

successUrl.description: Where the customer returns after paying

title.description: Shown on the page, e.g. "Coffee" or "Balance top-up"

name: qutpay_update_payment_link
title: Update a payment link
